scope: Passive coupled transverse strain is lateral displacement minus gain times axial shortening. A single law applies to all poses. Stiffness is provisional, and the law is not tied to a manufactured lattice. The earlier lead length lower bound is still used. Prescribed GH and rigid-only checks do not measure free-drive range.
